migration.source: Current exact QA ProtocolData tipping settings and existing endorsers_whitelist; no Organizer role changes.

state.inputProvenance: Projected output 1 of this unsigned code transaction, not an existing/live cell.
state.signingBlockedUntil: The exact code transaction is committed and its output 0 live with the pinned TypeID, owner, capacity and ELF data hash. Then recheck the protocol snapshot and every fixed state input (including actual code change output 1 when linked) before explicit user signing.

boundary: Public unsigned proposals do not reserve inputs and are not signed, VM-validated, broadcast or activated. State creation is a second transaction. Never substitute either anchor input or reorder output 0: that changes the Registry identity and requires rebuilding consumers. The state anchor depends on code transaction hash/output 1. Any code raw-body change requires a new state anchor and recompilation of all consumers. No current Protocol/User/Campaign/asset cell is spent. Connected-wallet preparation must preserve the reviewed raw body hash or stop.
